Thanks for the flag. Quick procurement checklist for a no-PO pilot exception:

• Pilot value < $15k total OR explicit business case signed by Sales lead (diego) — confirmed.
• AP routing: vendor must provide W-9 and preferred invoice routing email (ap@merchantauthority.com).
• PO exceptions require approval from Procurement Manager + Finance approver if the vendor is new and collects billing data.
• Exception lasts for the pilot only; for production we require normal PO flow.

Timing: I can review and approve the exception by end of day 11/21 if Merchant Authority returns the completed onboarding form and W-9. Laura B. — will you be available to co-sign from Finance?

If approved, please confirm who will receive invoices and whether Merchant Authority needs invoices to reference a billing contact.
